# Lead-scoring agent

*Client industry: B2B services | Completed: 2022-08-19 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p07*

## The problem
The client was a sales team qualifying inbound leads manually.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, LangGraph, an LLM orchestration framework, a typed async Python web API. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
